name: Siege of Acres
detailed_description:
Prepare for an unforgettable battle in Siege of Acres, an immersive RPG that blends intense combat, strategic planning, and community building into a thrilling defense experience. As the sworn protector of the town of Acres, it’s up to you to hold back nearly endless waves of ferocious monsters and formidable bosses' intent on obliterating everything in their path.

Key Features:

  • Character Development: Strengthen your hero through powerful upgrades, skill mastery, and gear customization. Your survival hinges on how well you prepare for the next onslaught.

  • Dynamic NPC Recruitment: Rally the citizens of Acres to your cause! Build relationships and recruit unique NPC allies to bolster your defenses. Each NPC brings their own strengths to the battlefield.

  • Solo or Co-op Gameplay: Face the chaos on your own or team up with friends to defend the town in multiplayer mode. Strategize together and create synergies to overcome overwhelming odds.

  • Relentless Waves of Foes: From monstrous hordes to towering bosses, every wave introduces new challenges that test your resolve, tactics, and reflexes.

  • Evolving Town of Acres: As you fight to protect Acres, watch the town grow and evolve, becoming a testament to your efforts.

short_description: In Siege of Acres, you’ll build and customize your character, honing their abilities to take on increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Equip powerful gear, master unique skills, and prepare for battles that will push your limits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMDRadeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 / AMD RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
